summary: Parke Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable July 17, 2026 to shareholders of record July 3, 2026. The dividend is a regular quarterly distribution, subject to Board discretion based on financial condition and regulatory restrictions. No premium or special terms are involved. The filing includes a press release and an inline XBRL exhibit. As a routine dividend declaration, this is not a special-situation transaction. No deal structure, advisor, or regulatory clock applies. Watch for future dividend sustainability given potential regulatory constraints on bank holding company distributions.
